option_relations.rationale: Behçet's Disease is a systemic inflammatory disorder, while Herpes Simplex Encephalitis is a viral infection of the brain. They are distinct conditions.
Autoimmune encephalitis is an inflammatory condition of the brain caused by an autoimmune response. Herpes Simplex Encephalitis is an infectious encephalitis. They have different etiologies.

Neuro-Behçet Disease is a neurological manifestation of Behçet's disease, a systemic inflammatory disorder. Herpes Simplex Encephalitis is a viral infection of the brain. They are distinct conditions.

Primary central nervous system vasculitis is an inflammatory condition affecting blood vessels in the brain. Herpes Simplex Encephalitis is a viral infection of the brain parenchyma. They are distinct conditions.
